description: Planetary positions and ephemeris API (NASA/JPL DE440): the ecliptic longitude, latitude, speed, retrograde flag and distance of the Sun, Moon, planets and lunar nodes at any moment 1800-2200, geocentric or heliocentric, ecliptic or equatorial (right ascension, declination). E.g. {datetime: '2026-10-01T12:00:00Z'}. Geocentric apparent positions from NASA/JPL DE440 (true ecliptic and equinox of date, IAU 2006/2000A), with the Moon's ascending and descending nodes and its mean apogee. Location is optional (only used to interpret a local time). Options: 'heliocentric' perspective (seen from the Sun) and 'equatorial' coordinates (right ascension, declination, and whether |declination| exceeds the obliquity). Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/positions (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

ambiguous_time.description: Which occurrence to use when a local time happens twice (DST fall-back).

datetime.description: Local civil date-time, ISO 8601: '1990-05-15T14:30' (local clock time at the place) or with an explicit offset '1990-05-15T14:30:00+02:00'. Alternative: 'date' + 'time'.

bodies.description: 'all' or a list from ['sun', 'moon', 'mercury', 'venus', 'mars', 'jupiter', 'saturn', 'uranus', 'neptune', 'pluto', 'lunar_node_true', 'lunar_node_true_descending', 'lunar_node_mean', 'lunar_apogee_mean']. Default: the Sun, the Moon, Mercury..Pluto, the Moon's true ascending node, its descending node and its mean apogee.

coordinates.description: 'ecliptic' (default: longitude/latitude) or 'equatorial': also each body's right ascension, declination, their daily speeds and whether |declination| exceeds the obliquity of the ecliptic.

perspective.description: 'geocentric' (default) or 'heliocentric' (geometric, seen from the Sun: the Earth instead of the Sun and the Moon, no lunar points).

time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, 24 h. Omit if unknown (computed at 12:00 with a TIME_UNKNOWN warning).

time_basis.description: What the given clock time is: civil wall-clock (default), UTC, Local Mean Time, or true (apparent) solar time.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.

name: body_positions

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'astronomy/rise-set'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

points.description: One entry per body (Sun to Pluto, the Moon's ascending and descending nodes, its mean apogee): ecliptic longitude and latitude, daily speed, retrograde flag, distance in AU; with equatorial coordinates, right ascension, declination and whether |declination| exceeds the obliquity.

settings.description: Settings applied: the longitude reference (true equinox of date), perspective, coordinates.

subject.description: The resolved input: 'time' (local input, time zone and historical UTC offset, UT, Julian days, Delta T) and, when given, 'location' (latitude, longitude).

title: Planetary positions for any date (ephemeris)
